title: Provision native VIXEN tools in assigned WSL worktrees before the MSVC gate
body: The assigned vxtrain checkout had Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools but no VIXEN/.win-native-toolchain pins and no Ninja on Windows PATH. The required native build could not start until the documented build.bat provision flow ran from the lane checkout through the box queue. Provision the pinned CMake/Ninja/Vulkan toolchain during worktree setup, or let the native build bootstrap it before admission, so the native gate starts from a ready checkout.

title: Run merged SDI freshness check in the default VIXEN build
body: The fresh full queued cmake build completed with 26 codegen checks while sdi_tool merge-variants shaders/sdi-variants.json --check exited 6 for eight stale merged headers. The documented recovery was to run queued sdi_tool merge-variants shaders/sdi-variants.json and then recheck. Wire the existing merged SDI freshness check and its generated C++ compile contract into the default build so a successful build cannot leave stale checked-in shader interfaces.

title: Include Visual Studio Build Tools in build.bat vswhere discovery
body: The queued native command build.bat all vixen-ninja exited 1 with “no Visual Studio install with the C++ x64 toolchain was found”, although the pinned VS 2022 Build Tools and vcvars64.bat were installed. build.bat calls vswhere -latest -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 without -products *, so vswhere omits the Build Tools product. The supported workaround is to call vcvars64.bat and run the vixen-ninja CMake preset directly. Include Build Tools in the launcher query so its documented native entry point works.

title: Make native lane cache and Ninja job cap automatic in the VIXEN build
body: The native witness requires VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE=<assigned-worktree>/.tmp/fetch and VIXEN_MAX_BUILD_JOBS=4, but the standard launcher does not derive the lane-local fetch cache or apply the lane four-job cap automatically. Have the native launcher derive these values from its own checkout and queue admission so native builds do not need manual environment setup.

title: Run native MSVC configuration through a mapped worktree path
body: The queued native build started build.bat from a WSL UNC worktree path; CMake's MSVC compiler probe launched cmd.exe with a UNC build-directory cwd and cmd.exe fell back to C:\Windows\system32, failing the link step. Recovery is to start cmd.exe from a local drive cwd, pushd the assigned WSL worktree to a temporary drive letter, then invoke build.bat through that drive; reconfigure after preserving the incomplete UNC-keyed build/ninja cache. Make the native entry point handle this path mapping and cache identity automatically.

title: Scope Windows Git safe-directory trust to VIXEN's WSL FetchContent cache
body: The native MSVC configure launched Windows Git against a FetchContent clone inside the assigned WSL worktree and failed with 'detected dubious ownership'; its diagnostic suggested a persistent global safe.directory entry. A process-scoped GIT_CONFIG_COUNT safe.directory pattern for this worktree's FetchContent directory allowed the clone to be read without changing user configuration. Have the native launcher scope that trust to its own cache or place native FetchContent clones on a Windows-owned path.

title: Detect WSL Dozen provisioning from the host instead of a shared source path
body: A native Windows CMake configure evaluated EXISTS /dev/dxg through the WSL-backed source drive and treated the Windows process as WSL. It then invoked wsl.exe with the temporary drive-letter cwd, which failed translation and left a nonfatal Dozen provisioning warning. Gate the optional Dozen provisioner on the actual configure host/runtime or make it use the WSL-native source path independently of the Windows worktree drive.

title: Emit reflected integer vectors as typed SDI push-block members
body: After the merged SDI headers were regenerated, consumers failed because signed and unsigned SPIR-V vectors were emitted as uint8_t byte arrays, which cannot bind the reflected glm::ivec2/uvec4 values. A manual generator fix now selects typed integer vector declarations from the reflected base type and width, with a regression test. Keep the merged C++ interface emitter aligned with reflected integer-vector types so regenerated headers compile without a downstream repair.

title: Resolve the pinned Yeroket root and snapshot cache per VIXEN worktree
body: The native Windows configure defaulted YEROKET_ROOT to /Github/Yeroket-Fantasy, which is absent here; the documented -DYEROKET_ROOT override must point through the assigned WSL share. Its pinned snapshot cache also defaults under LOCALAPPDATA, outside the lane worktree; the documented VIXEN_KERNEL_CACHE_DIR override keeps the generated archive inside .tmp. Make native root discovery and isolated cache placement worktree-aware.

title: Keep native VIXEN compiler caches inside the assigned worktree
body: build.bat defaults CCACHE_DIR and SCCACHE_DIR to C:\ccache and C:\sccache. An isolated native witness must override these paths to the assigned worktree's .tmp directories so generated cache data does not spill into another lane's or machine-wide storage. Derive per-worktree compiler-cache paths in the launcher while preserving user overrides.

title: Pass native CMake cache overrides through the locked VIXEN launcher
body: The documented -DYEROKET_ROOT and -DVIXEN_KERNEL_CACHE_DIR settings are required for an isolated native configure, but build.bat's locked configure wrapper cannot forward cache arguments. I had to seed the preset cache with a queued direct CMake configure, then use build.bat build. Let the launcher accept and forward caller CMake arguments while retaining its configure lock and preset binary directory.

title: Make native kernel snapshot locking work in WSL worktrees
body: Queued Windows CMake configuration stalls in file(LOCK) at VixenKernelSnapshot.cmake:27 when the cache is inside the assigned WSL worktree. The same hang reproduced with a fresh lock file through both \wsl.localhost and \wsl$ paths, before the timeout or snapshot work; moving the cache outside the worktree is disallowed by lane isolation. Provide a Windows-over-WSL compatible lock or a supported worktree-local cache route, and keep snapshot ownership explicit.

title: Preserve graph-free shell materialization behavior
body: R504.1 moved shell derivation behind RenderGraph::TaskExecutor, but several existing BodyOctreeSceneNode render fixtures execute without an owning graph. To retain their prior synchronous publication semantics, this lane added a graph-free producer branch that synthesizes a completed AsyncRunResult and reuses the common publication path. Define graph ownership and standalone execution as an explicit node contract or provide a shared producer adapter, so each caller does not need its own body-level fallback.
